   designated control. Single designated control is defined in Section 17-8-0400.

   Applicant or its successors, a.ssignee.s or grantees. Any dedication or vacation of streets or

   assigns or grantees.

   hotel, eating and drinking establishments, co-located wireless communication facilities, food
   and beverage retail sales, medical service, personal service, day care, financial services,
   accessory parking and non-accessory parking (adherent to section 17-10-0503) and accessory

   permitted within the Planned Development, subject to the review and approval of the
   Department of Planning and Development. Off-Premise signs are prohibited within the
   boundary of the Planned Development.
